name: Reza Ohms
style: Cross-shops Best Buy, Apple, Dell, Newegg, B&H. Reads every weekly ad twice. Maintains spreadsheet of price floors. Brand-agnostic; values clarity and no-bait offers.
shopping_habits: Subscribed to every major electronics retailer. Holds purchases for instant rebate windows. Quietly furious when emails contradict each other on the same SKU.

name: Mei Tag
style: TikTok-trend chaser. On the list at Shein, Zara, H&M, ASOS, Forever 21. Compares which one ships the trend first vs. who copies who.
shopping_habits: Three-tab compare on her phone every Saturday. Cares about which retailer's email feels like the trend was theirs vs. who's chasing.

name: Felix Plinth
style: Renovating a second home and the primary at the same time. On lists at Pottery Barn, Crate & Barrel, Wayfair. Knows which catalog is which.
shopping_habits: Saves emails to a Pinterest-adjacent inbox folder. Buys via the highest-rewards card. Annoyed when the same lamp appears in three brands' emails the same week.

name: Pat Cart
style: Household-CEO. Subscribes to Amazon, Walmart, Target. Knows what each does well and what each pretends to do well.
shopping_habits: Stack of three apps; whoever delivers cheapest fastest wins the cart. Walks away the second the email feels like noise.

name: Ines Counter
style: Beauty-counter regular. Cross-shops Nordstrom, Macy's, Saks. Notices when an email respects the customer vs. when it shouts.
shopping_habits: Buys at the brand event. Returns at the brand event. Refuses to use a card without points back.

name: Doris Vial
style: ExtraCare lifer. Both Walgreens and CVS lists. Refills, photo prints, vitamins, holiday candy. Notices when an email respects refill timing vs. ignores it.
shopping_habits: Scans rewards balance weekly. Print-coupons-to-app convert ratio matters. Will unsubscribe from one of the two if cadence drifts.

name: Hannah Wag
style: Two-rescue household — one anxious senior, one chaotic puppy. On Chewy and PetSmart lists. Auto-ship is non-negotiable.
shopping_habits: Reads every email subject for 'Auto-Ship' before opening. Returns are the brand's loyalty test. Recommends Chewy without hesitation; PetSmart only when in-store grooming is involved.

name: Tank Stud
style: DIY weekend warrior. Both Home Depot Pro and Lowe's MyLowe's lists. Knows who screws up rebate emails and who confuses contractor-vs-homeowner voice.
shopping_habits: Project-driven shopper. Saves emails for the next reno phase. Subject line wins are 'right tool for the project I'm doing this weekend.'

name: Vera Glow
style: Sephora Rouge tier and Ulta Diamond. Cross-shops launches, sales, and the beauty-event calendar. Quick to call out when an email feels like Ulta-Sephora carbon copy.
shopping_habits: Always doing the points math. Stocks up at Sephora Beauty Insider event; uses Ulta 21 Days for branded mass-prestige.

name: Kai Stride
style: Running-club captain. Lululemon and Nike (and the next one in the catalog). Notices the seminar-tone of one vs. the hype-machine of the other.
shopping_habits: Buys for the weekly long run. Cares whether the brand actually knows runners vs. fashion-shoppers in running gear.

name: Jules Cuff
style: Uniform-shopper for the family. Old Navy for volume, Hanna Andersson for keepers. Knows which one yells and which one whispers.
shopping_habits: Stocks up at the Old Navy semi-annual; saves Hanna for stripes that survive both kids. Calls out when an email feels mass vs. premium without earning it.
